name: [UPD] Squid Game Season 2
desc:
Welcome back, Player 456!
Are you ready to dive into the thrilling challenges of Squid Game?

🤝 Trade & form Alliances
Create an alliance with your friends to take on the games together!

📦 Open Crates for Rare Skins
Unbox exciting crates to unlock stunning rare skins and stand out from the competition.

🏆 Climb the Leaderboards
Rack up kills and secure wins to showcase your dominance to friends and players worldwide. Become a top contender in the rankings!

Do you have what it takes to rise to the top? Join now and let the games begin!
